# DISC-02 — Contract and Manifest Reconciliation Report

## Scope and method

This report reconciles only the assigned Visual Office API contract, CR, two
frontend/design specifications, SmartGift requirement baseline, and runtime
manifest. It is a documentation finding, not endpoint, runtime, or LINE
delivery evidence. Per the API contract, browser paths are authoritative from
`docs/contracts/zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md`.

## Reconciliation result

The API contract, CR-012, frontend design specifications, and manifest agree
that Visual Office is an authenticated, tenant-scoped Zuri control plane. The
manifest is explicitly `configuration_only`; its versioned `path` values are
readiness-check identifiers and its `zuri_browser_path` values are the intended
same-origin Zuri routes. None of the reviewed artifacts proves that an endpoint
exists, that a runtime gate is implemented, or that LINE delivery is live.

### Review-lock ledger

| Lock | Reconciled contract position | Evidence | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| RBAC authority boundary | The server derives actor, tenant, roles, plan, and session state. Visual Office can select an existing user as a group reviewer but has no global role-administration action; Zuri Team/Employee RBAC remains the role authority. | API contract §§2.1–2.2; CR-012 Architectural Contract 1, 8–9; design spec §§2, 4; manifest `authority_model`; requirement baseline Contract Lock. | **Pass, with baseline amendment required.** RQ-02 and RQ-03 still say the Tenant Owner can assign/approve every tenant role, whereas the later Contract Lock restricts the Visual Office surface until the canonical RBAC contract proves that Owner flow. |
| Configuration-only group admission | A disabled/configured group and an enabled `answer` capability are not LINE runtime admission. The browser can save configuration and request preflight only; admission is server-owned and fail-closed. | API contract §§3, 4.2, 4.4, 6; CR-012 Architectural Contract 4 and 10; design spec §§1, 3, 6; manifest `group_runtime_guard`; requirement baseline Contract Lock. | **Pass, with superseded wording retained.** RQ-10's immediate auto-reply wording must remain explicitly superseded and must not be used for UI or implementation decisions. |
| Canonical server-verified group binding | The browser submits only opaque `groupBindingId` selected from the tenant-scoped binding list. It cannot submit or derive `tenantId`, `externalGroupRef`, LINE group ID, or OA ID; the server verifies the canonical same-tenant OA binding before configuration or preflight. | API contract §§2.1, 4.1–4.2, 6; design spec §§2, 4; manifest `group_runtime_guard`; requirement baseline Contract Lock. | **Pass.** The intended browser contract is consistent; implementation and tenant-isolation tests remain required. |
| Configuration-only report delivery | A saved report/schedule is not sent or live. Delivery requires a governed outbox, idempotency, runtime policy gate, recipient revalidation, receipt, retry/recovery contract, and audit evidence. | API contract §§3, 4.3–4.4, 6–8; CR-012 Architectural Contract 6 and 10; design spec §§1–2, 6; manifest `report_delivery_guard`; requirement baseline Contract Lock. | **Pass.** The baseline's report intent is constrained by its later Contract Lock; no reviewed artifact authorizes delivery. |

## Browser-path and manifest reconciliation

The ten manifest entries map exactly to the corresponding contract browser
paths. The manifest's `/v1/visual-office/...` value is not the browser path;
its paired `zuri_browser_path` is.

| Manifest runtime identifier | Contract browser path | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| `/v1/visual-office/overview` | `GET /api/visual-office/overview` | Exact mapped suffix; versioned identifier versus browser route. |
| `/v1/visual-office/group-bindings` | `GET /api/visual-office/group-bindings` | Exact mapped suffix. |
| `/v1/visual-office/groups` | `GET` and `POST /api/visual-office/groups` | Exact mapped suffix and modes. |
| `/v1/visual-office/groups/:groupId` | `PATCH /api/visual-office/groups/:groupId` | Exact mapped suffix; manifest does not include the contract's group-detail read. |
| `/v1/visual-office/groups/:groupId/activation-requests` | `POST /api/visual-office/groups/:groupId/activation-requests` | Exact mapped suffix; preflight-only in both. |
| `/v1/visual-office/reports` | `GET` and `POST /api/visual-office/reports` | Exact mapped suffix and modes. |
| `/v1/visual-office/reports/:reportId` | `PATCH /api/visual-office/reports/:reportId` | Exact mapped suffix; manifest does not include the contract's report-detail read. |
| `/v1/visual-office/review-queue` | `GET /api/visual-office/review-queue` | Exact mapped suffix; read-only/no-side-effect in both. |

The API contract contains eight browser paths with no manifest entry. This is
a manifest coverage difference only; it is not evidence that any route exists,
is implemented, or is authorized.

### Five frozen Visual Office contract paths

- `GET /api/visual-office/groups/:groupId`
- `GET /api/visual-office/groups/:groupId/reviewer-options`
- `PUT /api/visual-office/groups/:groupId/reviewers`
- `GET /api/visual-office/reports/:reportId`
- `GET /api/visual-office/review-queue/:candidateId`

### Three proposed Agent Office paths

- Proposed read: `GET /api/visual-office/office` (API contract §9.1). Its
  precise read-permission mapping remains unresolved: the Agent Office design
  targets a Tenant Owner, while the API contract currently specifies only a
  tenant-scoped read.
- Proposed future write: `POST /api/visual-office/agents/:agentId/messages`
  (API contract §9.2; Agent Office design §4). It remains disabled/unavailable
  until its conversation contract is accepted; it is not implemented or
  authorized.
- Proposed future write:
  `POST /api/visual-office/agents/:agentId/task-assignments` (API contract
  §9.2; Agent Office design §4). It remains disabled/unavailable until durable
  task-assignment admission is implemented; it is not implemented or
  authorized.

The design's protected page path `/visual-office/reports/:reportId` is a
browser page, not an API route. It deliberately differs from the authorized
data path `GET /api/visual-office/reports/:reportId`. The Agent Office page
`/visual-office/office` has only the three proposed paths above and no
approved functional interaction.

## Required reconciliation actions before functional binding

1. Amend or annotate requirement baseline RQ-02, RQ-03, and RQ-10 so their
   supersession by the Contract Lock is unambiguous at the requirement row.
2. Decide whether the eight contract-only paths belong in the readiness
   manifest; if they do, preserve the distinction between the five frozen
   Visual Office contracts and the three proposed Agent Office paths, without
   asserting implementation, authorization, or runtime readiness.
3. Keep Visual Office role administration unavailable until the canonical Core
   RBAC/Team contract and tenant-scoped tests prove the required Owner flow.
4. Keep group runtime and report delivery blocked until every stated server-side
   admission evidence item is accepted. A contract, manifest entry, audit ID,
   configured record, or preflight response is insufficient by itself.

## Handoff

DISC-02 is ready for an independent authority/runtime/binding/delivery
consistency review. It does not close VO-FE-00, authorize frontend API binding,
or change the `configuration_only` runtime status.

## Review Report — DISC-02

**Verdict: PASS (documentary correction applied)** — the evidence for the four
review locks remains materially sound. The path reconciliation now accounts
for all eight contract paths absent from the manifest, while preserving that
none is evidence of endpoint implementation or authorization.

| Gate | Result | Evidence | Required fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Completeness *(hard gate)* | **PASS (corrected)** | The inventory now contains all eight paths absent from the manifest: five frozen Visual Office contracts and three proposed Agent Office paths. The two Agent Office writes are explicitly recorded as proposed future contracts, not implemented or authorized endpoints. | Complete. The Office read's precise read-permission mapping remains explicitly unresolved: the design targets a Tenant Owner while API contract §9.1 currently says only tenant-scoped. |
| 2. Traceability *(hard gate)* | **PASS (corrected)** | Each proposed Agent Office write is traced to API contract §9.2 and Agent Office design spec §4, including its disabled/unavailable state. | Complete. |
| 3. Internal consistency *(hard gate)* | **PASS (corrected)** | The report consistently identifies eight paths absent from the manifest: five frozen Visual Office read/write paths and three proposed Agent Office paths (one read, two writes). None is described as implemented or authorized. | Complete. |
| 4. RBAC authority boundary | **PASS** | The report correctly preserves API contract §§2.1–2.2 and CR-012 Architectural Contract 8–9: session-derived authority, no Visual Office global role administration, and Zuri Team/Employee RBAC as the canonical role surface. It correctly flags the requirement baseline RQ-02/RQ-03 wording as superseded by its Contract Lock. | Retain the finding. Add the proposed Office read-permission mapping as an unresolved detail when correcting completeness. |
| 5. Group admission and canonical binding | **PASS** | The report correctly separates configuration from runtime admission and identifies opaque, tenant-scoped `groupBindingId` as the only browser-submitted group reference, per API contract §§3, 4.2, 4.4, and 6; manifest `group_runtime_guard`; and requirement baseline Contract Lock. | Retain the finding; do not promote preflight, a configured record, or `answer` capability to LINE enablement. |
| 6. Report delivery boundary | **PASS** | The report correctly treats reports as configuration-only and names the required outbox, idempotency, policy gate, recipient revalidation, receipt, retry/recovery, and audit evidence, consistent with API contract §§4.3–4.4 and the manifest `report_delivery_guard`. | Retain the finding; no live-delivery claim is permitted. |

### Review conclusion

The hard-gate documentary corrections are complete: the browser-path section
accounts for all eight contract paths absent from the manifest and traces the
three Agent Office paths to their proposed/unapproved status. This correction
does not establish endpoint existence, implementation, authorization, runtime
readiness, or LINE delivery.

## Re-review Report — DISC-02

**Verdict: ALL PASS** — The appended DISC-02 review findings have been fixed
in the report. This is a documentary verdict only; it does not establish
endpoint existence, authorization, runtime admission, or LINE delivery.

| Hard gate | Verdict | Re-review evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Completeness | **PASS** | The manifest contains 10 method/path entries and the frozen core contract contains 15. The report now inventories all five core entries absent from the manifest, then separately accounts for all three proposed Agent Office entries. |
| Traceability | **PASS** | The five frozen core entries are traceable to API contract §§4.1–4.3. The Agent Office read is traceable to §9.1; both proposed writes are traceable to §9.2 and the Agent Office design interaction rules. |
| Consistency | **PASS** | The report consistently distinguishes versioned manifest readiness identifiers from `zuri_browser_path`, configuration from runtime/delivery admission, and frozen core contracts from proposed Agent Office contracts. No unmanifested path is represented as implemented or authorized. |

The four review locks remain accurately represented: server-derived RBAC with
Zuri Team/Employee as the global-role authority; configuration-only group
admission; opaque, server-verified tenant-scoped `groupBindingId`; and
configuration-only report delivery with all runtime evidence still required.
The report also correctly retains the baseline RQ-02/RQ-03/RQ-10 amendment as
an open source-artifact action rather than misrepresenting it as resolved.
